Name: Chest Inventory Advisor
Author: chyyo
Description:
[size=6]Chest Inventory Advisor 🌿[/size]
[i]For little hoarders who have everything in their chests… except a plan.[/i]
Ever stared at a chest full of crops and wondered what to do with them?
This mod was born on one of those afternoons — 400 mods installed, an entire shed filled with chests, and mountains of crops saved for no particular reason.
[b]Chest Inventory Advisor[/b] is your little farm consultant! It helps you decide what to sell, what to process, and how to make the most of everything you've been hoarding.
[line]
[color=#fafafa][size=4]✨ Features[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]🌱 [b]Smarter Processing[/b] — Compare processing routes, profits, and time efficiency to find the best use for your harvest.
Screenshot from game[/*]
[*]⭐ [b]Perfection First[/b] — Automatically reserve items you still need to ship for Perfection before optimizing profits. (Toggle this option whenever you like.)[/*]
[*]🧺 [b]Inventory & Ingredients[/b] — Check available materials across storage, identify missing ingredients, and plan what to process.[/*]
[*]🔍 [b]Item & Recipe Guide[/b] — Explore processing recipes, alternative uses, ingredient sources, crop seasons, and fishing information.[/*]
[*]🏡 [b]Storage Browsing[/b] — Easily switch between chests.[/*]
[/list]Theoretically supports [b]All Language[/b], automatically following your game language.
[line]
Updates 10/26/26
[img width=406]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54277/54277-1792994007-998566541.jpg[/img]

[list]
[*]🎨 [b]Adjustable Text Size[/b] — Choose from 85% to 120% in 5% steps.[/*]
[*]📍 [b]Flexible Button Placement[/b] — Keep the analysis button on the left, drag it to a custom position, or hide it and use your shortcut.[/*]
[*]⚙️ [b]Quick Settings[/b] — Open settings directly from the advisor. With Generic Mod Config Menu installed, you can also customize the shortcut and button placement.[/*]
[/list][line]
[heading]🧩 Compatibility & Mod Support[/heading]
[b]Yes, modded recipes are supported![/b] 🌿
Chest Inventory Advisor can recognize compatible custom items, machines, and processing recipes, including recipes added by other mods.
[b]Optional integrations:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Chests Anywhere[/b] — Chest names, categories, and storage organization.[/*]
[*][b]Producer Framework Mod[/b] — Supported custom production rules.[/*]
[*][b]Extra Machine Configs[/b] — Supported custom machine rules.[/*]
[/list]These integrations are optional, not required.
[b]Please note:[/b] Some complex modded recipes, dynamic conditions, or custom machine behaviors may not be fully recognized. Routes with unknown values won't be treated as guaranteed profits.
[heading]📦 Installation & Usage[/heading]
[b]Requirements:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.1.0+
[list=1]
[*]Download and unzip the mod.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]ChestInventoryAdvisor[/code]folder in your game's
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list][b]To use:[/b] Open a chest and click the chest-and-coins icon, or press [b]F8[/b].
[i]This mod is read-only. It won't move, sell, or process your items.[/i]
[line]
[heading]🌸 中文介绍[/heading]
[b]专为选择恐惧症的仓鼠们打造！一个属于你的农场私人顾问。[/b]
灵感来源于某个装了 400 个 Mod、箱子摆满一整个小屋、囤了一大堆作物，却不知道拿它们怎么办的午后。
草莓应该直接卖、做果酱还是酿酒？哪个更赚钱？值得等那么久吗？
Chest Inventory Advisor 帮你分析库存、比较加工收益，让每一份囤货都有它的用武之地！
[b]主要功能[/b]
[list]
[*]🌱 [b]加工收益分析：[/b] 比较加工路线、收益与时间效率。
游戏截图[/*]
[*]⭐ [b]优先完美度：[/b] 预留尚未完成出货要求的物品。(此功能可手动关闭）[/*]
[*]🧺 [b]库存与备料：[/b] 检查现有材料、缺少的辅料及预计收益。[/*]
[*]🔍 [b]物品百科：[/b] 查询加工配方、其他用途与获取途径。[/*]
[*]🏡 [b]箱子切换：[/b] 轻松浏览不同箱子内作物的配方和分析。[/*]
[/list][line]
[b][size=4]10/26/26更新[/size][/b]
[img width=405]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54277/54277-1792994149-934904604.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]🎨 [b]文字大小：[/b] 跟随游戏字体，支持 85%–120% 调整，每 5% 一档。[/*]
[*]📍 [b]自定义按钮位置：[/b] 支持左侧自动放置、拖拽到自定义位置，或隐藏按钮、仅使用快捷键。[/*]
[*]⚙️ [b]快捷设置：[/b] 在库存助手内直接打开设置；安装 Generic Mod Config Menu 后，还可调整快捷键和按钮位置。[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]🧩 Mod 兼容性[/b]
支持游戏原版及可识别的 Mod 自定义物品、机器和加工配方！
可选兼容 Chests Anywhere、Producer Framework Mod、Extra Machine Configs 和 Generic Mod Config Menu，无需全部安装。
部分复杂的自定义配方、特殊条件或机器逻辑可能无法完整解析，因此不保证所有 Mod 配方都能参与收益计算。
[b]📦 安装与使用[/b]
需要 Stardew Valley 1.6+ 和 SMAPI 4.1.0+。
将解压后的
[code]ChestInventoryAdvisor[/code]文件夹放入
[code]Mods[/code]目录。
打开箱子，点击宝箱金币图标或按 [b]F8[/b] 即可使用。
[i]本模组只提供建议，不会自动出售、移动或加工物品。[/i]
